collection_rules: Search engine first to discover public indexed direct ad pages, then visit those links directly.
Archive raw public pages only under data/raw, which is gitignored.
Hash source URLs in processed records.
Redact phone numbers, email addresses, and contact handles in processed records.
Reject hard browser-verification, CAPTCHA, access-denied, and UI-boilerplate pages.
Document source exhaustion when volume targets cannot be reached through public collection.
No CAPTCHA solving, login-gated scraping, or technical access-control circumvention.
